name: Sroki
source: A girl named Ira works as a composer. She writes excellent music, but Ira has one flaw - a tendency to procrastinate. Previously, the girl managed to successfully complete the work in a short time, but this time, when the music was ordered by a serious artist Nikolai Laskovy, she launched the case too hard. Help Ira to finish her work on the last day!
translation: 一位名叫伊拉的女孩以作曲为业。她写得一手好曲子，却有个拖延的毛病。过去，她总能在短时间内顺利完成工作；但这一次，严肃认真的艺术家尼古拉·拉斯科维向她委托创作音乐，她却把事情拖得太久了。帮助伊拉在最后一天完成作品吧！
